comment: Positions from the 2026-09-04 Discord /tp list, with swords/foods/tools moved 1 block forward toward the exhibit walls. Indoor Discord rotations were written pitch-then-yaw; 1.8.9 takes yaw then pitch, and the reference PNGs are level, so those shots are stored as <yaw> 0. Blocks faces the utility cluster at yaw 0. Sky stays level (pitch 0) so packs that put a character on the horizon stay centered. Vanilla Sky/sun are off so they do not draw a second dome through that view. The nether exhibit is built in the overworld, so that shot stays in dimension 0.
